text:
support-bot: New high-priority ticket from tenant acme-eu: repeated 504s + auth failures. customer says requests appear routed to us-east even with EU pin. ticket: #ACME-8891

elaine.yang: Seen the ticket. initial check — they started seeing spikes ~2026-03-16T08:22Z. Can someone look at routing logs and any failover events?

mike.kim: I can grab router logs. Suspect a failover to global fallback pool; our routing policy should respect `residency=EU` pin though.

raj.patel: Pulling audit logs now. Compliance alerts triggered for cross-region data path: `residency-violation: true` for a subset of requests. Looks correlated to `acme-eu` key.

olivia.martin: Customer reports also seeing auth token rejections: `403` with message "token-region-mismatch". Might be our auth service rejecting because the token issuer region != serving region.

mike.kim: Here's a snippet from the region router around 08:21-08:24Z:
```
2026-03-16T08:21:57Z ROUTER route req id=xyz tenant=acme-eu prefer_region=eu-west4 allocated_pool=global-fallback-01
2026-03-16T08:22:01Z FAILOVER reason=capacity_shortage target_pool=global-fallback-01
2026-03-16T08:22:01Z AUDIT emit residency_exemption candidate=true req_id=xyz
```

elaine.yang: Why did router pick global-fallback-01 instead of eu-dedicated or eu-burst? That pool shouldn't serve EU-pinned requests unless flag `allow_cross_region_failover` is set.

raj.patel: I see a recent rollout of autoscaler policy changes for Dedicated pools that temporarily set `burst_fallback=true` for several customers to handle GPU pressure. Change was deployed 2026-03-16T07:59Z. It appears the config did not have an override to block EU residency pins.

olivia.martin: That explains billing mismatches too — fallback pool is in us-east billing tenant, so tokens validated differently and usage shows on wrong billing account. Customer called outraged.

elaine.yang: Immediate mitigation: disable burst_fallback for acme-eu and set forced routing to `eu-west4` for their API key. Raj, can you push that? Also create a temporary RBAC exception to let ops pin that key.

raj.patel: On it. Running control-plane patch: `PATCH /v1/tenants/acme-eu/routing {"force_region":"eu-west4","allow_burst":false}`. Applied at 2026-03-16T08:30:12Z. Confirmed new decisions hit router cache within 30s.

mike.kim: Verified in router logs: after 08:30:40Z requests start routing to `eu-dedicated-03`. No more 504s in the next 10 minutes for sample traces.

support-bot: Customer updated: "we're seeing fewer errors now, but want audit and compensation for data residency break and billing misattribution". They requested full repro + timeline.

compliance-bot: Audit alert: emitted 42 residency exceptions for tenant acme-eu between 08:21:50Z and 08:30:12Z. Flagged for compliance review. Ticket appended: `compliance-review-ACME-8891`.

olivia.martin: Short repro notes for the postmortem:
- Preconditions: Dedicated eu-dedicated capacity pressure + autoscaler rollout with `burst_fallback=true`.
- Trigger: router policy allowed fallback pool without residency exception checks.
- Observable errors: `504` from inference gateway, `403 token-region-mismatch` from auth service, billing attribution recorded to fallback pool account.
- Quickfix: control-plane patch forcing region, rollback autoscaler flag.

elaine.yang: Follow-ups: 1) Revert autoscaler change and do a canary that preserves residency pins. 2) Add a hard block in routing policy: `if tenant.residency == 'EU' then disallow_fallback_pools`. 3) Compensation plan template for customers impacted (billing + SLA credits). 4) Postmortem and compliance packet due EOD.

raj.patel: I'll create the rollback PR and schedule the canary. PR: #infra/2127. Setting follow-up tasks in the ticket.

mike.kim: Also adding a quick detection rule in Console: graph `unexpected_cross_region_routes` when audit emits residency_exemption=true and target_pool != tenant.region for >10 requests in 5m.

olivia.martin: I contacted ACME support contact at 08:41Z, they want hourly updates until resolved.

elaine.yang: Good work. Keep threads short in ticket. We'll coordinate compliance packet and customer comms. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket updated with mitigation notes and compliance flag. #ACME-8891 now in Escalated > On-Call > Compliance.

compliance-bot: Reminder: preserve PII — do not paste full request payloads in Slack. Use secure doc linked in the ticket.

raj.patel: Last log snippet showing normal routing after fix:
```
2026-03-16T08:30:41Z ROUTER route req id=abc tenant=acme-eu prefer_region=eu-west4 allocated_pool=eu-dedicated-03
2026-03-16T08:30:41Z AUTH success req id=abc issuer_region=eu-west4
```
elaine.yang: Closing interim incident thread. We'll publish full postmortem after compliance signoff."
